label: Rectal cancer
note: Configurable by the clinical team. Includes a restaging rule for re-discussion after neoadjuvant therapy. The required records are rebuilt from the NCG work-up (NCG rectal cancer guideline, and the NCG colon flow for MMR / MSI and RAS / BRAF); NCG GI guidelines carry no Essential / Optimal / Optional letters, so the listed work-up is treated as Essential and the items NCG calls optional or select-only as Optional. Prototype defaults; to be confirmed by the hospital Tumour Board (clinical review before real use).
settings_note: NCG setting of the Case File, chosen by the clinician from what the signed reports record (the system never computes stage). Item 4.1 derives the required records per setting from the NCG tiers.
